_comment: Caster Picks scene content. 4 casters in quadrant order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each pick resolves by explicit `image` path first, then by `name` lookup in /data/riftbound/riftboundCardNames.json. `photo` null falls back to the slot's current PSD photo layer (logan / naomi / julian / steph — the bg's baked photos are a stale take and always stay covered). To swap a photo, set `photo` to an asset path and optionally override placement with photoX/photoY/photoW/photoH (defaults are the PSD slot bounds).
